content.title: Chapter 54 - MOTOR VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC — Sec. 54-95. - Exceptions; public employees.
content.summary:
It shall not be unlawful for any city employee, or other public employee, to operate
               motorized vehicles for the purpose of maintaining, repairing or doing work for the
               public, or the city, on any city-owned lands, as defined in this article.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 1, 8-29-2…
